author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**


GO:0071962 | mitotic sister chromatid cohesion, centromeric | IBA with PTN008577749 , Q5FBB7

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

sgo2 https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC15A10.15

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

propagation, a tricky one!
in fission yeast, Sgo1 is the cohesion protector and Sgo2 is the error-correction and orientation factor. This is the reverse of how the names map onto function in mammals.

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue:

author: marcfeuermann
body: Here, the confusion stems not simply from the gene names but from the topology of the tree, which suggests events of horizontal gene transfer AND duplications between fungi and vertebrates. I removed the annotations for the fungi and was only able to annotate the two vertebrate nodes separately.
